lcc_original: 洪水氾濫在地上四十天。水越往上長，越把樓船漂起，使它離地上升。
notes: 越...越... parallel adverb structure (appearing twice) is LCC's stylistic addition with no Hebrew counterpart; both 越 left unannotated
方舟 (UNV) → 樓船 (LCC): different lexical choices for the ark (H08392 mapped to 樓船)
LCC restructures UNV '從地上漂起' as '漂起，使它離地上升': H05375→漂 and H07311→起 (preserving same character-to-SN correspondence as UNV); H04480+H05921→離; H0776→地上; 使它 and 升 are unannotated Chinese additions
{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} retained as implicit — LCC has no explicit word for the Hebrew narrative copula וַיְהִי, just as UNV does not
